item.title: Supply Chain Lead - StrangeLove
item.description: Join StrangeLove and lead supply planning across a dynamic, fast-growing FMCG business.
item.job:description:
At StrangeLove, we do things differently. We're a premium Australian beverage brand known for our award-winning mixers, lo-cal sodas and mineral waters. Backed by Asahi Beverages, we combine the support and scale of a leading beverage company with the agility, personality and entrepreneurial mindset of a fast-growing independent brand.

We're looking for a Supply Chain Lead to take ownership of our end-to-end supply planning process and play a critical role in supporting the next phase of growth for the StrangeLove business.

item.title: Business Development Executive - Retail ACT
item.description: Own a Canberra retail territory, build customer partnerships and grow Asahi’s iconic beverage portfolio.
item.job:description:
Your Impact

Own your patch. Build trusted partnerships. Help great brands win in store.

As a Business Development Executive, you will manage an established independent retail territory across Canberra North, with regular trips to Goulburn, Yass and Crookwell. You will partner with independent bottle shops and grocery customers to grow distribution, improve promotional execution and identify practical opportunities to increase sales, visibility and brand presence.

You will typically visit up to six customers each day and manage a regular fortnightly call cycle. This is a hands-on field sales role with plenty of variety, autonomy and customer contact. item.title: Lead Graphic Designer - NZ
item.description: Exciting opportunity for a design professional who thrives in a busy and dynamic FMCG environment and enjoys balancing people leadership, project management, and creative execution.
item.job:description:
Your Impact

 

 

We're seeking an experienced Lead Graphic Designer to lead our in-house Graphic Design team while remaining hands-on in delivering impactful creative projects. This is an exciting opportunity for a design professional who thrives in a busy and dynamic FMCG environment and enjoys balancing people leadership, project management, and creative execution.

 

 

You will lead the end-to-end delivery of graphic design projects while leading team workflow, capability development and continuous improvement initiatives. You will work closely with stakeholders across Innovation, Shopper Marketing, Brand and Supply Chain to ensure projects are delivered on time and to the highest standard.
